info.title: InertiaSharp.Cli
info.description: Interactive CLI to scaffold InertiaSharp starter projects (Vue / React / Svelte × MVC / Minimal API × SQLite / PostgreSQL / SQL Server)

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: InertiaSharp CLI — scaffold ASP.NET Core + Inertia.js starter projects
x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Interactive wizard that asks you:
1. API style   : MVC Controllers or Minimal API
2. Database    : SQLite, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server
3. Frontend    : Vue 3 + Reka UI, React + shadcn/ui, or Svelte +
shadcn-svelte
4. Auth        : ASP.NET Core Identity (login, register, profile,
permissions)
or a simple home page with a database query
